name: Ningyou Aika
source:
Near future. Advances in science allowed to use androids for sex treatment. Hero is owner of black android enterprise that tweaks androids to suit client specific needs, including personality tweaks. New such request arrived today, but noone could think then it was a trap that could claim man's life.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
近未来。科学进步让人们能用仿生人进行性治疗。主人公经营一家黑市仿生人企业，能按客户的具体需求调整仿生人，甚至改变人格。今天又收到一项委托，但无人料到，那竟是足以夺走男人性命的陷阱。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
